title: Import leaks its capture temp dir when killed mid-merge: sweep stale rocket-agents-conversation-import-* dirs at import start
notes: Observation: `importConversationExport.ts:22` creates `$TMPDIR/rocket-agents-conversation-import-*/capture.sqlite`; a run killed mid-merge never reaches its cleanup, and nothing removes it later. On the MacBook `rocket-agents-conversation-import-D7qHpg` (8220 MB, 2026-10-28, no open handles) sat for three days while the disk fell to 17 GB free; it was deleted by hand. Each live run also needs about 23 GB of temporary space (7.7 GB capture plus 15 GB in `rocket-agents-conversations.*`). On 2026-10-31 the hourly `com.cristian.atrium-refresh` ran a full import on the MacBook at about 16:13, 19:33 and 21:45 UTC, each taking free disk from about 40-50 GB down to 16-26 GB for 15-25 minutes, now under `~/p/wiki/atrium/tmp` (8 GB capture plus a 6.5 GB `slice.jsonl`). Smallest step: at import start, remove `rocket-agents-conversation-import-*` directories older than a day that no process holds, as `removeAbandonedArchiveTemporaries` already does for archive temporaries.

2026-11-24 audit: not done. importConversationExport.ts still mkdtemp()s rocket-agents-conversation-import- under tmpdir() (line 23) and only rm()s it in finally, so a SIGKILL leaks it; no sweep exists (grep finds the prefix only in that file; removeAbandonedArchiveTemporaries handles only <archive>.tmp-<pid> files). No commit touches this since 8e766b6. Next: add a one-export file that removes import-* dirs older than a day with no live holder, call it at import start. Atrium now uses ~/p/wiki/atrium/tmp, so check that location too.
result: Import leaks its capture temp dir when killed mid-merge: sweep stale rocket-agents-conversation-import-* dirs at import start
evidence: importConversationExport sweeps abandoned import directories before mkdtemp and writes owner.pid. Removal only for a dead owner pid, or no owner file and mtime older than 24 h; everything uncertain is kept and logged. CONVERSATION_IMPORT_DIRECTORY_SWEEP_TEST.ts 2 pass. Limit: only the current TMPDIR is swept; not run end to end against the real archive.
